# Weed Insurance Agency — Cannabis Business Insurance

> Weed Insurance Agency is a specialty division of Contractors Choice Agency. We provide insurance for cannabis businesses across all license types — dispensaries, cultivators, processors, distributors, and hemp/CBD operators. Most standard carriers decline cannabis. We shop the specialty surplus markets that write it right.

## What We Do

Cannabis remains federally classified as Schedule I, meaning standard admitted carriers (The Hartford, Nationwide, State Farm, Travelers) will not write cannabis business insurance. CCA's cannabis specialty division accesses surplus and non-admitted markets specifically underwriting cannabis risk: Amwins cannabis programs, Berkley One cannabis, Admiral Insurance cannabis division, CannGen, and Cover Cannabis.

We are NOT a captive of one program. We are an independent agency that shops all cannabis specialty markets for the best coverage and price for your operation type and state.

## Core Services

- Cannabis Dispensary Insurance (GL, product liability, crime, property, WC, cyber)
- Cannabis Cultivator & Grower Insurance (crop, property, equipment breakdown, GL)
- Cannabis Processor & Extractor Insurance (product liability, pollution liability, equipment)
- Hemp & CBD Business Insurance (product liability, crop, e-commerce)
- Cannabis Product Liability Insurance (all segments, supply chain)
- Cannabis Crime & Theft Insurance (employee dishonesty, robbery, burglary)

## Key Coverage Concepts

**Non-admitted/surplus lines insurance:** Real, claims-paying coverage from specialty carriers that operate outside the admitted market. Required for cannabis because admitted carriers decline. Major carriers like Amwins, Admiral, and Berkley are financially rated and pay claims.

**Product liability:** Critical for every cannabis business in the supply chain. Plaintiffs name cultivators, processors, distributors, AND dispensaries in product liability lawsuits. Every segment needs this coverage.

**Cannabis crime insurance:** Cannabis businesses operate predominantly in cash due to federal banking restrictions. Standard GL and property do NOT cover employee theft, robbery, or burglary. Commercial crime insurance is required.

**State licensing requirement:** Most cannabis states require proof of GL insurance before issuing or renewing a license. We issue compliant ACORD 25 certificates same-day.
